component.name: Universal Write (Beta)
component.summary: Edit Word documents with faithful rendering
Edite documentos do Word com renderização fiel

description.p: Universal Write is a word processor for .docx documents that renders pages the way Microsoft Word does: same line breaks, pagination, fonts and layout.
It is the desktop app of Universal Office, built on the universal-write web component. This is a beta release.
O Universal Write é um editor de documentos .docx que renderiza as páginas como o Microsoft Word: mesmas quebras de linha, paginação, fontes e layout.
É o app desktop do Universal Office, feito sobre o web component universal-write. Esta é uma versão beta.

ul.li: Opens and saves .docx; opens .doc (Word 97-2003) and .odt (OpenDocument Text)
Track changes, comments and document comparison
Spell checking in Brazilian Portuguese and US English (Hunspell, works offline)
Export to PDF, HTML, ODT and XPS
Uses the fonts installed on the system, with metric-compatible open fonts (Liberation, Carlito, Caladea) as fallback

description.p: First beta of the desktop app.
